name: JavaScript Plugin Loader
description: System plugin that loads TurboDL plugins written in JavaScript. Embeds QuickJS (one runtime + context per script), exposes a stable `host`/`plugin` ABI with coarse-grained capabilities (http, crypto, log, storage, env, time, timers), bridges link parsers and task hooks into the ordinary extension points, and enforces an ACTIVE → STOPPING → DRAINING → DISPOSED unload sequence that never closes a runtime while its JavaScript is executing. Implements no concrete cloud or protocol plugin itself.
author: TurboDL
